description:
Create a new Reflect test which contains an ordered list of steps.

**Toolset:** Tests

**Parameters:**
- name (string) *required*: Name of the test to create.
- type (enum) *required*: Platform of the test.
- description (string): Optional description of the test.
- deviceProfile (string): Device profile id. Required for a 'web' test; ignored for 'api' and 'native-mobile'. One of: 'desktop', 'tablet', 'mobile'.
- steps (array) *required*: Ordered list of steps that make up the test. Web tests must begin with a 'browser-navigate' step. Prefer deterministic, selector-based steps ('click', 'input', 'submit', 'text-validation', 'hover', etc.) over AI-driven 'prompt' steps whenever a stable selector is available. Reserve 'prompt' steps for behavior that can't be expressed with a selector. Any text field in a step (e.g. 'inputText', 'url', 'expectedText', 'requestBody', header values, prompt text) may embed Reflect variable and function references using '${...}' syntax, which are resolved at run time: '${var(name)}' inserts the value of a parameter/variable named 'name' (declare parameters via the top-level 'parameters' field, or assign them mid-run with an 'update-parameters' step); '${sec(name)}' inserts the value of the account secret 'name'. Functions generate dynamic values: '${alphanum(n)}', '${alpha(n)}', '${num(n)}' (random alphanumeric / alphabetic / numeric string of length n), '${range(min, max)}' (random integer, inclusive), '${time(offsetMs)}' and '${datetime(offsetMs)}' (current epoch-millis / date-time, with an optional millisecond offset), and '${date(format, offsetDays)}' (current date formatted with tokens like 'MM/dd/yyyy', with an optional day offset).
- parameters (array): Optional named parameters (variables) for the test, each with a 'name' and optional default 'value'. Reference a parameter's value inside any step text field with '${var(name)}'.

deviceProfile.description: Device profile id. Required for a 'web' test; ignored for 'api' and 'native-mobile'. One of: 'desktop', 'tablet', 'mobile'.

name.description: Name of the test to create.

parameters.description: Optional named parameters (variables) for the test, each with a 'name' and optional default 'value'. Reference a parameter's value inside any step text field with '${var(name)}'.

steps.description: Ordered list of steps that make up the test. Web tests must begin with a 'browser-navigate' step. Prefer deterministic, selector-based steps ('click', 'input', 'submit', 'text-validation', 'hover', etc.) over AI-driven 'prompt' steps whenever a stable selector is available. Reserve 'prompt' steps for behavior that can't be expressed with a selector. Any text field in a step (e.g. 'inputText', 'url', 'expectedText', 'requestBody', header values, prompt text) may embed Reflect variable and function references using '${...}' syntax, which are resolved at run time: '${var(name)}' inserts the value of a parameter/variable named 'name' (declare parameters via the top-level 'parameters' field, or assign them mid-run with an 'update-parameters' step); '${sec(name)}' inserts the value of the account secret 'name'. Functions generate dynamic values: '${alphanum(n)}', '${alpha(n)}', '${num(n)}' (random alphanumeric / alphabetic / numeric string of length n), '${range(min, max)}' (random integer, inclusive), '${time(offsetMs)}' and '${datetime(offsetMs)}' (current epoch-millis / date-time, with an optional millisecond offset), and '${date(format, offsetDays)}' (current date formatted with tokens like 'MM/dd/yyyy', with an optional day offset).

argument.description: Argument for the Appium command in an 'appium' step.

command.description: Appium command to run. Required by 'appium' steps.

description.description: Human-readable description of the step. For 'prompt' steps, this field holds the natural-language instruction to execute.

filters.description: Filters selecting which inbound email this step waits for.

fromAddress.description: Only match emails sent from this address.

fromName.description: Only match emails sent from this sender name.

subject.description: Only match emails with this subject.

toAddress.description: Only match emails sent to this address.

text.description: Text to extract from, or validate against, the matched email.

expectedResponse.description: Expected response for a 'prompt' step: a boolean for an 'assert' prompt, or a string for a 'query' prompt.

expectedResult.description: Expected result text for a 'prompt' step.

expectedText.description: Text expected on the page. Used by 'text-validation' steps, which require an exact match of the target element's text (not a substring or case-insensitive match).

followRedirects.description: Whether an 'api' step should follow HTTP redirects.

httpMethod.description: HTTP method for an 'api' step (e.g. 'GET', 'POST'). Defaults to 'GET'.

id.description: Id of the segment to reference. Required for 'segment' steps.

inputText.description: Text to type. Used by 'input' steps.

name.description: Optional display name for the step.

parameters.description: Parameter name/value assignments applied by an 'update-parameters' step.

promptType.description: The kind of AI 'prompt' step (required for 'prompt' steps): 'action' performs an action; 'assert' checks a condition; 'query' answers a question. Prompt steps only take into account what is currently visible on the screen.

script.description: JavaScript source to execute. Used by 'javascript' steps.

seconds.description: Number of seconds to pause. Used by 'wait' steps.

selector.description: CSS selector of the target element. Used by 'click', 'input', 'submit', 'scroll', 'focus', 'hover', 'text-validation', 'text-highlight', and the source element of 'drag-and-drop'.

filters.description: Filters selecting which inbound SMS this step waits for.

fromNumber.description: Only match SMS messages sent from this number.

toNumber.description: Only match SMS messages sent to this number.

text.description: Text to extract from, or validate against, the matched SMS.

tag.description: Tag name of the target element (e.g. 'button', 'input').

title.description: Expected page title for a navigation step ('browser-navigate', 'browser-back', 'browser-forward', 'browser-refresh').

toSelector.description: CSS selector of the destination element for a 'drag-and-drop' step.

toTag.description: Tag name of the destination element for a 'drag-and-drop' step.

type.description: The kind of step to perform. Determines which of the other fields are required.

url.description: Target URL. Required by 'api' steps; used as the navigation URL for 'browser-navigate' and as the deep link for 'deeplink'.
